newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens tumbles after announces results. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Siemens tumbles after announces results. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]

text.p: Shares in German electronics company Siemens fell sharply on Wednesday after the firm said 1995/96 group net profit was 2.49 billion marks ($1.6 billion), compared with 2.08 billion the previous year.
Siemens shares fell almost two marks from a day high of 80.70 marks to 78.60 marks, down 1.37 marks, or over 1.6 percent in an overall stronger market.
The DAX index of 30 leading shares was up 9.40 points, or 0.35 percent at 2725.56.
Siemens said it saw no improvement in results for the 1996/97 financial year.
